# The Ubuntu packages CI's jobs install, by set: a job names its set (.github/actions/apt, `set`),
# and ci.yml's packages job fetches every set, on each runner it is used on, into GitHub's cache
# first. `name: packages`, separated by spaces.
wasm: clang lld llvm
linux: gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu flex bison bc linux-source-6.8.0 qemu-user clang lld
difftest: clang lld llvm gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu qemu-user
alpine: clang lld
